entities.summary: Commodore Alireza Tangsiri was an Iranian naval officer who served as the commander of the IRGC Navy. On 26 March 2026, the Israel Defense Forces announced that they had assassinated Tangsiri during the 2026 Iran war. On 30 March 2026, Iran's Revolutionary Guard Corps confirmed Tangsiri died after sustaining serious injuries.
